title: [Switch 2] The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time $89 + Delivery Only ($0 to Metro/ $99 Regional Order) @ Big W
body:
Deal: [Switch 2] The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time $89 + Delivery Only ($0 to Metro/ $99 Regional Order) @ Big W

[19199090] if you want foil version, best bet to go in person, I have heard they have them on the shelves sometimes. chances are if you order online, you likely wont get it. could also check jb and price match there if you find a foil copy
[f4te] Still cheaper via https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/974880
[caviar] Not if you do the newsletter sign up, thats listed in that deal
https://www.bigw.com.au/sign-up?srsltid=AYCX9vKf4-7hGwpWrCm2…
[SKS01] It's quite difficult to get that voucher in comparison with Target.
[Legendalvin] Has anyone tried “PC version” of the game ?
[PeelThis] Yeah tried lichii and hookshot but settled on frichii
Runs well with my hardware, up to zora's domain and i'm hooked
[banterbants] Using NX2Navi. Runs well enough at max settings 1080p. Averaging 40-50fps but using framge gen gets me 120, can't feel any latency issues and plays well.
[HaydosK] No but I’m waiting till it’s perfect before I dive in. I might buy the foil one and keep it sealed as a collectors item and also then I won’t feel bad downloading the game
[Morien] Just an FYI, Nintendo Australia don’t seal their games. If you want a sealed copy you’ll have to order from EU or US and in that case, good luck getting a non-scalped foil version.
[nov1911] for linux with 9070xt I find longshot to be best, no stutters or bugs so far, solid 60fps at 4k
lichii is cool cause it has cheat/mods but stutters a lot
nx and hookshot were decent
[YoursTruly] …⚠️
.⚠️⚠️
🧚 Lisssseeen!!
Fun fact: did you know that ‘Navi’ is a short form of ‘Navigation’? (That’s how they named her)
[Freestyle] I hope some of the other Nintendo games comes to sale too lol
[hawktalk] I paid $85 straight from the eshop.
I don't want to keep harping on about it, I'm not a huge fan of the series. Didnt play the original on N64 (did try it on the NSO….. didn't finish it) .
I had some spare credit from the Coles eshop card deal from a while back… figured why not. Presentation wise the graphics are great, sounds great, controls are great. Nintendo did well.
[HaydosK] They are cheaper digitally but then you don’t get the reversible map, resell value or foil cover.
[speedyjonzalas] Bloody great remake. The scores it has recieved are fully well deserved.
Coming from someone who played tbe original in the 90s. (It looks exsctly how i remember it!)
[Ethan Bargain-Hunt] I never played the original so this was my first experience with what I've read is lauded as one of the best games of all time.
I see why.
I was sucked into this world so quickly where so many games have lost me in recent years as my attention span has wanned. Phenomenal game, worth every dollar.
